briefdescription.para: Lower all instructions that def or use vreg_1 registers.

detaileddescription.para: In a first pass, we lower COPYs from vreg_1 to vector registers, as can occur around inline assembly. We do this first, before vreg_1 registers are changed to scalar mask registers.
Then we lower all defs of vreg_1 registers. Phi nodes are lowered before all others, because phi lowering looks through copies and can therefore often make copy lowering unnecessary.
